title: I wish guests would just send me their photos
caption:
I wish guests would just send me their photos.

Share one upload link, and guests drop their photos in while you shoot. Each upload lands in your Snap inbox, waiting for your review before anything is shared.
0% commission, free to start.

It is not magic: you still send the link and choose what to keep. Snap just collects them in one place.

Start free at snaphq.app
